items.body:
# HER Hack-Astron # 7 | Spark-X2.6 Open Source AI for Good Challenge

Build something useful for people who need it. This round invites you to use **Spark-X2.6-4B** to create a working application for disaster response, health, accessibility, gender equality, or another public-interest need.

**Go to [Spark-X2.6-4B on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B), give the model a ❤️ Like, and download and use it to build your application. Publish your complete project with a video or illustrated demo in the model's Hugging Face Community Discussions, then reply to this event Issue with the Discussion link.**

- Model and getting started: https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B
- Publish your project (Hugging Face Community Discussions): https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B/discussions
- Submit your Discussion link (reply to this event Issue): https://github.com/XHToken/Spark-X2.6/issues/16

## Quick Summary

1. Individuals of any gender are welcome. For team entries, at least 50% of contributors must identify as women, following the HER Hack-Astron participation rule.
2. Your application must actually use Spark-X2.6-4B. Explain what the model does in the application.
3. Every submission must include **a video demo OR an illustrated demo with screenshots and explanatory text** showing the application running.
4. Publish the complete entry in Spark-X2.6-4B's Hugging Face Community Discussions, then reply to this announcement Issue with the direct Discussion link.
5. AI-assisted development is allowed; disclose how it was used. AI personas must not be presented as human participants.
6. No live presentation is required.
7. One winner receives **USD 100**. No upfront participation or prize-claim fee is required.

## Schedule

- Submissions open: **October 23, 2026 (UTC)**
- Submission deadline: **October 31, 2026, 23:59 UTC**
- Beijing time equivalent of the deadline: **November 1, 2026, 07:59 (UTC+8)**
- Judging and winner announcement: after submissions close; updates will be posted in this Issue.

**UTC is the authoritative time zone for the event.**

## Challenge Tracks

Choose one or combine several. Other applications with a clear public benefit are also welcome.

- **Disaster preparedness and response**: organize public emergency information, structure requests for assistance, match supply information, or support multilingual communication.
- **Health and well-being**: explain health education materials in plain language, support appointment preparation, or help users keep health and care records.
- **Accessibility**: simplify complex text, assist with reading and communication, or help people navigate public services.
- **Gender equality**: identify and explain gender bias in text, improve access to support resources, or create tools supporting equal participation in education and employment.
- **Other public-interest applications**: elder support, inclusive education, environmental protection, community mutual aid, or volunteer coordination.

Focus on a specific group of users and a concrete problem. Show how your application helps them and where its limitations remain.

## How to Participate

1. Visit [Spark-X2.6-4B on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B), click **❤️ Like**, and follow the model card to download and run the model.
2. Build a working application that uses Spark-X2.6-4B. Record the model revision, runtime, hardware, precision or quantization, and key inference settings. If using a mirror, identify the source and corresponding revision.
3. Prepare **one of the following required demo formats**:
   - **Video demo**: a screen recording showing the scenario, user input, application workflow, and actual output. A duration of 2–5 minutes is recommended.
   - **Illustrated demo**: screenshots with step-by-step explanations showing the same end-to-end workflow. Include actual inputs and outputs.
   
   Concept slides, promotional images, or descriptions without a running demonstration are insufficient.
4. Create a **new Discussion in [Spark-X2.6-4B's Hugging Face Community](https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B/discussions)**. Include `HER Hack-Astron # 7` in the title, for example: `[HER Hack-Astron # 7] [Open Source AI for Good] <Project name>`.

   Publish the complete project description, video or illustrated demo, model usage, and reproduction instructions in that Discussion. Embed screenshots or provide publicly accessible video links, and check that reviewers can access them.
5. Reply to **[this event's GitHub Issue](https://github.com/XHToken/Spark-X2.6/issues/16)** with the direct Discussion link, for example: `https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B/discussions/<number>`. This completes your submission. For team entries, also list all contributors and their profiles in your reply. Keep subsequent project updates in the same Discussion.

**Submission requires both steps: publish the complete project in the designated Hugging Face Community Discussion, then leave its link in this event's GitHub Issue. GitHub-only or other-platform-only submissions are not accepted.**

## Submission Template

Copy the following into your Hugging Face Discussion:

```markdown
## Project name and track
Project name:
Track:

## Who this helps and what problem it solves
Target users:
Concrete scenario and problem:
Expected public benefit:

## How Spark-X2.6-4B is used
Model source and revision:
The model's role in the application:
Other models, tools, or services used, if any:

## Demo (required: video OR illustrated walkthrough)
Video link / embedded screenshots:
Example input:
Application workflow and actual output:

## How to reproduce
Code repository or runnable example, if available:
Setup and run instructions:
Runtime and versions:
Hardware and precision/quantization:
Key prompts and inference settings:

## Results and limitations
Observed results and how they were evaluated:
Failure cases and current limitations:

## Contributors and disclosure
Individual / team:
Contributor profiles and respective contributions:
AI-assisted development disclosure:
Data sources and authorization, if applicable:
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Real use**: Spark-X2.6-4B must perform an identifiable function in the demonstrated application.
- **Working demo**: include a video or illustrated walkthrough showing a complete interaction with actual model output.
- **Clear public benefit**: identify intended users, the problem, and how the application helps.
- **Reproducibility**: provide sufficient setup details, prompts, model revision, and environment information for others to reproduce the core workflow. Open-source code and runnable examples are encouraged.
- **Honest reporting**: distinguish demonstrated functionality from planned features; report limitations and failures. Explain the method and sample size behind any quantitative claims.
- **Originality and privacy**: submit your own work, acknowledge data and dependencies, and remove personal information, access tokens, and other secrets from demos and logs.
- **Responsible application boundaries**: for health and emergency scenarios, describe the scope of the prototype and when human or professional review is needed.
- **Complete submission**: publish the complete project in Spark-X2.6-4B's Hugging Face Community Discussion and reply to this announcement with its direct link before the deadline.

For team entries, list all contributors and their profiles; at least 50% must identify as women. Do not post sensitive identity or payment documents publicly.

## Judging Criteria

- Public benefit and understanding of user needs: **30%**
- Application usefulness and demo completeness: **25%**
- Substantive use of Spark-X2.6-4B and execution evidence: **20%**
- Reproducibility and technical clarity: **15%**
- Honest evaluation and explanation of limitations: **10%**

## Award

**Winner: 1**

- Cash prize: **USD 100**
- Honorary title: **HER Hack-Astron Spark-X2.6 Open Source AI for Good # 7 Champion**

International winners may use PayPal, bank transfer, or another available payment method. Winners in Mainland China may coordinate an available domestic RMB payment channel. After the announcement, provide any necessary prize-claim information privately through the contact below.

## Contact

- Partnerships, challenge questions, and prize claims: [ifly_opensource@iflytek.com](mailto:ifly_opensource@iflytek.com)
- Enterprise WeChat assistant and developer community: [HER Hack-Astron partner invitation — Contact Us](https://opensource.iflytek.com/blog/her-hack-astron-call-for-partners#联系我们)

**Like the model, build with it, and share a demo that shows how AI can help people.**

---

# 中文

# HER Hack-Astron # 7｜Spark-X2.6 公益应用场景挑战赛

让 AI 走进真实的公益场景，为需要帮助的人解决一个具体问题。

本期挑战邀请你使用 **Spark-X2.6-4B**，围绕**应急救灾、健康、无障碍、性别平等**等方向，开发一个可以实际运行的公益应用，并通过**视频或图文 Demo**展示使用过程与效果。

**前往 [Hugging Face 模型主页](https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B)，为 Spark-X2.6-4B 点亮 ❤️ Like，下载并使用模型完成你的公益应用，在模型的 Hugging Face Community Discussions 发布完整作品，再到本活动 Issue 留言提交链接！**

- 模型下载与使用指南：https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B
- 完整作品发布区（Hugging Face Community Discussions）：https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B/discussions
- 投稿登记（在本活动 Issue 下留言）：https://github.com/XHToken/Spark-X2.6/issues/16

## 快速摘要

1. 任何性别的个人参赛者均可参加；团队参赛沿用 HER Hack-Astron 规则，女性贡献者占比须不低于 50%。
2. 必须实际使用 Spark-X2.6-4B，并说明模型在应用中承担的功能。
3. **必须提供视频 Demo 或图文 Demo，二选一即可，展示应用真实运行过程。**
4. 在 Spark-X2.6-4B 的 Hugging Face Community Discussions 发布完整作品，再在本活动 Issue 下回复 Discussion 直达链接。
5. 允许使用 AI 辅助开发，但须披露使用方式，不得将 AI 角色冒充真人参赛者。
6. 无需现场或实时演示。
7. 设置 **1 名优胜奖，奖金 100 美元**；参与和领奖无需支付预付费用。

## 赛程

- 开放提交：**2026 年 10 月 23 日（UTC）**
- 提交截止：**2026 年 10 月 31 日 23:59（UTC）**
- 对应北京时间：**2026 年 11 月 1 日 07:59（UTC+8）**
- 评审与获奖公布：截止后进行，进展将在本 Issue 更新。

**本活动面向全球，以 UTC 时间为准。**

## 赛题方向

任选一个方向，也可以组合；其他具有明确公益价值的应用同样欢迎。

- **应急救灾**：公开应急信息整理、求助信息结构化、物资供需信息匹配、多语言沟通辅助等。
- **健康**：健康科普材料通俗化、就医沟通准备、健康与照护记录整理等。
- **无障碍**：复杂文本简化、阅读与表达辅助、公共服务信息获取与使用辅助等。
- **性别平等**：文本中的性别偏见识别与解释、支持资源导航、促进教育与就业平等参与的工具等。
- **其他公益场景**：助老服务、普惠教育、环境保护、社区互助、志愿者协作等。

请聚焦具体的服务对象和真实问题，展示应用能提供什么帮助，以及目前仍有哪些局限。

## 参与与提交方式

1. 访问 [Spark-X2.6-4B 模型主页](https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B)，点击 **❤️ Like**，参考模型卡中的使用指南下载并运行模型。
2. 完成一个实际使用 Spark-X2.6-4B 的公益应用。记录模型 revision、运行框架、硬件、精度或量化方式及关键推理参数；使用镜像时注明来源与对应 revision。
3. 准备以下任意一种**必需的 Demo 材料**：
   - **视频 Demo**：录屏展示使用场景、用户输入、应用操作流程及真实输出，建议 2–5 分钟。
   - **图文 Demo**：使用运行截图配合逐步说明，展示完整操作流程，包含真实输入和输出。
   
   仅有概念介绍、宣传图或未展示实际运行的方案说明，不构成有效 Demo。
4. 在 **[Spark-X2.6-4B 的 Hugging Face Community Discussions](https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B/discussions)** 新建公开帖子。标题包含 `HER Hack-Astron # 7`，例如：`[HER Hack-Astron # 7] [公益应用] <作品名称>`。

   在 Discussion 中发布完整作品介绍、视频或图文 Demo、模型使用说明和复现步骤。可嵌入运行截图或提供公开可访问的视频链接，请确认评审能够访问。
5. 在 **[本活动 GitHub Issue](https://github.com/XHToken/Spark-X2.6/issues/16)** 下留言，提交 Discussion 的直达链接，例如：`https://huggingface.co/XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B/discussions/<编号>`，即完成投稿。团队参赛请同时在留言中列出全部贡献者及其个人主页。后续作品补充或更新请放在同一个 Discussion 中。

**投稿须完成两步：先在指定 Hugging Face Community Discussion 发布完整作品，再到本活动 GitHub Issue 下留言提交链接。仅发布在 GitHub 或其他平台，不构成有效投稿。**

## 投稿模板

新建 Hugging Face Discussion 时，可复制以下模板填写：

```markdown
## 作品名称与方向
作品名称：
参赛方向：

## 服务对象与解决的问题
目标用户：
具体场景与痛点：
预期公益价值：

## Spark-X2.6-4B 使用说明
模型来源与 revision：
模型在应用中承担的功能：
使用的其他模型、工具或服务（如有）：

## Demo（必填：视频或图文二选一）
视频链接 / 运行截图：
示例输入：
应用操作流程与实际输出：

## 复现方式
代码仓库或可运行示例（如有）：
安装与运行步骤：
运行框架及版本：
硬件与精度 / 量化方式：
关键 Prompt 与推理参数：

## 效果与局限
已观察到的效果及评估方式：
失败案例与当前局限：

## 贡献者与披露
个人 / 团队：
贡献者个人主页及分工：
AI 辅助开发使用说明：
数据来源与授权说明（如涉及）：
```

## 验收标准

- **真实使用**：Spark-X2.6-4B 在所展示的应用中承担明确、可说明的功能。
- **实际演示**：视频或图文 Demo 展示一次完整交互，并包含模型的真实输出。
- **公益价值清晰**：说明服务谁、解决什么问题，以及应用如何提供帮助。
- **核心流程可复现**：提供模型 revision、环境、关键 Prompt 和操作步骤，鼓励开源代码或提供可运行示例。
- **结果诚实**：区分已实现功能与未来计划，说明失败案例和局限；量化效果需交代评估方法和样本量。
- **原创与隐私**：提交自己的作品，注明数据与依赖来源；截图、视频及日志须去除个人隐私、访问令牌等敏感信息。
- **应用边界明确**：涉及健康或应急场景时，说明原型适用范围及需要人工或专业人员复核的环节。
- **按时完成投稿**：在截止前于 Spark-X2.6-4B 的 Hugging Face Community Discussion 发布完整作品，并在本活动 Issue 下留言提交 Discussion 直达链接。

团队参赛请列出全部贡献者及其个人主页，女性贡献者占比须不低于 50%。请勿公开提交敏感身份或收款材料。

## 评审维度

- 公益价值与用户需求理解：**30%**
- 应用实用性与 Demo 完整度：**25%**
- Spark-X2.6-4B 的实际应用与运行证据：**20%**
- 可复现性与技术说明：**15%**
- 效果评估的诚实度与局限说明：**10%**

## 奖项设置

**优胜奖：1 名**

- 现金奖励：**100 美元（USD 100）**
- 荣誉称号：**HER Hack-Astron Spark-X2.6 Open Source AI for Good # 7 Champion**

国际获奖者可使用 PayPal、银行转账等可用收款方式；中国大陆获奖者可协商通过可用的境内渠道以人民币收款。获奖公布后，请通过下方联系方式私下提供必要的领奖信息。

## 联系我们

- 合作、活动咨询与领奖邮箱：[ifly_opensource@iflytek.com](mailto:ifly_opensource@iflytek.com)
- 企业微信小助手及开发者交流群：见 [HER Hack-Astron 合作伙伴招募页「联系我们」](https://opensource.iflytek.com/blog/her-hack-astron-call-for-partners#联系我们)

**为模型点亮 Like，用 Spark-X2.6-4B 做出你的公益应用，把真实 Demo 分享到 Hugging Face Community Discussions，再到本活动 Issue 留言提交链接，让更多人看到 AI 可以带来的帮助。**

---

items.title: [Bounty] Задача: Дописать тесты
items.body:
### 赏金平台 / Platform
GitHub

### 原始链接 / Source URL
https://github.com/vlad441/ncpp/issues/1

### 漏洞描述 / Description
Задача: Дописать тесты

## Задача: Дописать тесты

Нужно дописать тесты для непокрытых функций и методов для модулей которые зафиксированы документацией (например, парсеры JSON/BSON/CBOR, криптографические алгоритмы, структуры данных, системные модули, сеть и т.д.). 

В рамках существующей инфраструктуры тестирования ([tests.cpp](https://github.com/vlad441/ncpp/blob/dev/tests/tests.cpp) в `dev` ветке, можете следовать этому референсу).

🔗 [Документация](https://github.com/vlad441/ncpp/blob/dev/docs/ru/introduction.md)

## Требования к реализации

### Среда
   - Использовать существующую реализацию тестового раннера (`tests.cpp`).
   - Применять существующие макросы и функции логирования/проверок (`NextTest()`, `TEST_EQ()`, `TEST_NE()`, и др.).

### Критерии качества
   - Каждая функция должна быть протестирована как минимум на 1 положительный и 1 негативный сценарий. (Опционально сценарии с обработкой ошибок / краевыми условиями (`edge cases`, невалидные данные, выход за границы)).
   - Все тесты должны успешно проходить компиляцию в `СI/CD`.
   - *Примечание:* Если в процессе написания тестов обнаружился баг в самой функции (из-за чего тест падает), **не нужно подгонять тест под ошибку**. Зафиксируйте корректное поведение в тесте и оформите `issue` (или предложите исправление в коде функции).
   - Запрещено скрывать предупреждения компилятора или подавлять ошибки без веских архитектурных оснований.

#### 🛡️ Минимальное вмешательство и изоляция кода
- PR должен содержать **только** тесты (в рамках существующего раннера `tests/tests.cpp` и/или соответствующих файлов в `tests/units/`), за исключением исправления багов.
- **Обнаружение багов:** Если в процессе написания тестов вы обнаружили баг в коде библиотеки, **не исправляйте его молча** в том же PR. Зафиксируйте ошибочное поведение в тесте (или создайте отдельный `issue`).

### Ограничение на использование ИИ (AI Policy)
   - **Запрещено**: генерация PR целиком с помощью AI-агентов/ботов, автогенерация комментариев, а также слепой копипа

### 积分币奖励 / Coin Reward
62 coins

### 真实赏金（USD）/ Real Reward
$50

### 难度 / Difficulty
Medium

### 认领方式
评论 `/claim` 锁定任务 24h

> 查看 [REWARD_POLICY.md](REWARD_POLICY.md) 了解兑换规则

**Checker:** [`bounties/routes-time/check.yml`](https://github.com/amiller/bounty-arcade/blob/8232383/bounties/routes-time/check.yml) at `8232383`, run with `node check.mjs bounties/routes-time/check.yml <patch>` in the dev image. Nobody reviews the result.

Most recorded GPX has `<time>` on each point. Parse it to `time` (ms since epoch; a point without `<time>` has no `time` property, since existing tests deep-compare points) and add a pure `timing(points)` returning `{ elapsed, moving, avgSpeed }`, where `moving` sums only intervals whose speed is at least 0.5 m/s and `avgSpeed` is total distance over moving time in m/s; all three are `null` if any point lacks a time. Show elapsed and moving time as `h:mm:ss` in new `#stat-elapsed` and `#stat-moving` cells, and `—` when absent.

Acceptance tests (`bounties/routes-time/`):
- `parses time`: `<trkpt lat="0" lon="0"><time>2026-01-01T00:00:00Z</time></trkpt>` parses to `time === Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1)`; a point without `<time>` has no `time` property.
- `elapsed`: three points 60 s apart give `elapsed === 120000`.
- `stops excluded`: points at (0,0) t=0, (0,0.001) t=60 s, (0,0.001) t=600 s give `elapsed === 600000`, `moving === 60000` and `avgSpeed` within 0.01 of `haversine(...)/60`.
- `missing time`: one point without time makes all three fields `null`.
- `format`: `formatDuration(3723000) === '1:02:03'`, `formatDuration(null) === '—'`.
- Browser: bundled samples (no times) show `—` in `#stat-elapsed`; uploading a timed 3-point file (moving 1 minute, then stopped 1 minute) shows `0:02:00` in `#stat-elapsed` and `0:01:00` in `#stat-moving`.

items.title: [routes] Gain/loss threshold
items.body:
**App:** `apps/routes`
**Amount:** not yet funded
**Base commit:** `5c76d40`
**Checker:** [`bounties/routes-threshold/check.yml`](https://github.com/amiller/bounty-arcade/blob/8232383/bounties/routes-threshold/check.yml) at `8232383`, run with `node check.mjs bounties/routes-threshold/check.yml <patch>` in the dev image. Nobody reviews the result.

Raw GPS and barometer noise inflates elevation gain: the flat Riverside Loop reports 53 m. Add `stats(points, { threshold })` (metres, default 0, which keeps current results) that counts a climb or descent only once elevation has moved at least `threshold` from the last counted turning point (hysteresis); once a climb is counted, every further rise extends it until elevation falls `threshold` below the high point, and likewise for descents. Add a numeric input `#threshold` (data-testid `threshold`, default 0) that recomputes the stats panel.

Acceptance tests (`bounties/routes-threshold/`):
- `default matches raw`: for both samples, `stats(points)` and `stats(points, { threshold: 0 })` return identical gain and loss.
- `noise ignored`: elevations `[100, 101, 100, 101, 100]` with threshold 2 give gain 0, loss 0.
- `real climb counted`: elevations `[100, 101, 100, 105, 104, 110]` with threshold 2 give gain 10, loss 0 (not 12 and 2).
- `descent counted`: `[200, 190, 191, 180]` with threshold 3 gives gain 0, loss 20.
- `climb extends`: `[100, 103, 104, 102]` with threshold 2 gives gain 4, loss 2.
- `net preserved`: for the riverside sample, threshold 1 gives gain below 50 m (raw is 52.6 m) and `|gain - loss| < 1`.
- Browser: setting `#threshold` to 1 on Riverside Loop changes `#stat-gain` to a value other than `53 m`.

items.title: [routes] Segments and gaps
items.body:
**App:** `apps/routes`
**Amount:** not yet funded
**Base commit:** `5c76d40`
**Checker:** [`bounties/routes-segments/check.yml`](https://github.com/amiller/bounty-arcade/blob/8232383/bounties/routes-segments/check.yml) at `8232383`, run with `node check.mjs bounties/routes-segments/check.yml <patch>` in the dev image. Nobody reviews the result.

`parseGpx` flattens every `<trkpt>` into one list, so a GPX with two `<trkseg>` blocks (a paused recording, or a ferry crossing) counts the straight line across the gap as distance. Return `segments: [[point, ...], ...]` alongside `points` (`points` stays the flat list), and add `stats(points, { segments })` (default `[points]`) whose distance and gain/loss sum within segments only. Draw each segment as its own `<polyline>` in `#track`.

Acceptance tests (`bounties/routes-segments/`):
- `parses two segments`: a GPX string with two `<trkseg>` blocks of 2 and 3 points gives `segments.length === 2`, lengths `[2, 3]`, and `points.length === 5`.
- `distance skips gaps`: segments `[(0,0),(0,0.01)]` and `[(10,10),(10,10.01)]` give `stats(points, { segments }).distance` within 1 m of `haversine((0,0),(0,0.01)) + haversine((10,10),(10,10.01))`.
- `gain skips gaps`: segment elevations `[100, 110]` and `[500, 490]` give gain 10 and loss 10.
- `samples unchanged`: both bundled samples have one segment and `stats(points, { segments })` gives the same distance as before (4020.8 m and 9105.4 m, within 1 m).
- Browser: uploading a file with segments (0,0)–(0,0.01) and (0.01,0.01)–(0.01,0.02)–(0.02,0.02) via `#file` yields `#track polyline` count 2 and `#stat-distance` `3.34 km` (4.45 km with the gap).

items.title: [puzzle] Shareable replay links
items.body:
**App:** `apps/puzzle`
**Amount:** not yet funded
**Base commit:** `5c76d40`
**Checker:** [`bounties/puzzle-replay-links/check.yml`](https://github.com/amiller/bounty-arcade/blob/8232383/bounties/puzzle-replay-links/check.yml) at `8232383`, run with `node check.mjs bounties/puzzle-replay-links/check.yml <patch>` in the dev image. Nobody reviews the result.

Let a player share a solution as a URL such as `/apps/puzzle/#level=2&moves=lLLLrrrddLLL`.
On load, the page selects that level and replays the moves; the replay must stop
with an error message in `#status` if a move is blocked. Add `replayUrl(levelIndex, state)`
and `parseReplay(hash)` to `logic.js`, and a "Copy link" button with
`data-testid="share"` that writes the URL to `#share-url` (a read-only input).

Acceptance tests (`test/replay.test.js` and `test/replay.spec.js`):
- `parseReplay round-trips`: `parseReplay('#level=2&moves=lLLLrrrddLLL')` deep-equals `{ level: 2, moves: 'lLLLrrrddLLL' }`.
- `replayUrl encodes history`: `replayUrl(0, play(parse(levels[0].map), 'rRR'))` equals `'#level=0&moves=rRR'`.
- `parseReplay rejects junk`: `parseReplay('#level=x&moves=q')` throws.
- Playwright `replay link solves a level`: goto `/apps/puzzle/#level=2&moves=lLLLrrrddLLL`, assert `#level` value `2`, `#moves` text `12`, `#status` contains `Solved`.
- Playwright `blocked replay reports the step`: goto `/apps/puzzle/#level=0&moves=l`, assert `#status` contains `blocked` and `#moves` is `0`.

items.title: [puzzle] Persist progress and best scores per level
items.body:
**App:** `apps/puzzle`
**Amount:** not yet funded
**Base commit:** `5c76d40`
**Checker:** [`bounties/puzzle-progress/check.yml`](https://github.com/amiller/bounty-arcade/blob/8232383/bounties/puzzle-progress/check.yml) at `8232383`, run with `node check.mjs bounties/puzzle-progress/check.yml <patch>` in the dev image. Nobody reviews the result.

Players lose their place on reload. Store, per level name, whether it was solved
and the fewest moves used, and restore the last selected level on load. Keep the
bookkeeping pure in `logic.js` as `recordWin(progress, levelName, moves)` returning
a new progress object; `ui.js` reads and writes it under the `localStorage` key
`puzzle-progress`. The level `<select>` shows a check mark and the best move count
for solved levels.

Acceptance tests (`test/progress.test.js` and `test/progress.spec.js`):
- `recordWin stores first result`: `recordWin({}, 'Corner', 12)` deep-equals `{ Corner: { best: 12 } }`.
- `recordWin keeps the lower count`: `recordWin({ Corner: { best: 12 } }, 'Corner', 20).Corner.best === 12` and with `9` it is `9`.
- `recordWin does not mutate input`: the argument object is unchanged after the call.
- Playwright `best score survives reload`: solve level 1 with `ArrowRight` x3, reload, assert the option with value `0` contains `3` and a check mark (`✓`).
- Playwright `last level is restored`: select option value `2`, reload, assert `#level` has value `2` and `#moves` is `0`.

items.title: [puzzle] Deadlock detection for boxes stuck in corners
items.body:
**App:** `apps/puzzle`
**Amount:** not yet funded
**Base commit:** `5c76d40`
**Checker:** [`bounties/puzzle-deadlock/check.yml`](https://github.com/amiller/bounty-arcade/blob/8232383/bounties/puzzle-deadlock/check.yml) at `8232383`, run with `node check.mjs bounties/puzzle-deadlock/check.yml <patch>` in the dev image. Nobody reviews the result.

A box pushed into a corner that is not a goal can never move again, and the
player only finds out much later. Add `deadBoxes(state)` to `logic.js`, returning
the sorted indices of boxes that sit on a non-goal cell with a wall on one
vertical side and one horizontal side. The UI marks those cells with a `dead`
class and shows "Stuck: a box is in a corner" in `#status`.

Acceptance tests (`test/deadlock.test.js`):
- `deadBoxes returns [] for every level's start`: `deadBoxes(parse(lv.map))` deep-equals `[]` for each entry in `levels.json`.
- `corner box is dead`: `deadBoxes(play(parse(levels[1].map), 'DLdR'))` (level "Corner") deep-equals `[28]`.
- `dead box in a larger level`: `deadBoxes(play(parse(levels[4].map), 'URurDD'))` (level "Storeroom") deep-equals `[33]`.
- `box on a goal in a corner is not dead`: `deadBoxes(parse(['####', '#@*#', '####']))` deep-equals `[]`.
- `wall on one side only is not dead`: `deadBoxes(parse(['######', '#@$ .#', '#    #', '######']))` deep-equals `[]`.
- Playwright `marks dead box`: select option value `1` ("Corner"), press `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowRight`; assert `#board .dead` has count 1, it is the 29th `.cell` (index 28), and `#status` contains `Stuck`. Then click `undo` and assert `#board .dead` has count 0.
